# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old at his arrival; older in subsequent volumes  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c22 P18](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0018), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v3 c22 P23](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a small boy with bare, brown heels and fat legs. He loses a front tooth which he sells to Milty Boulter for two cents.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v2 c24 P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024)_

## Personality

Davy is mischievous, curious, and frequently gets into trouble or unlawful pleasures, though he expresses a desire to be good. He is loud, outspoken, and inquisitive, continually asking questions about how things work. He can be mischievous toward his sister Dora, though he sometimes shows generosity toward her.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P45](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0045), [v2 c19 P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 c22 P15](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0015), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v3 c13 P44](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0044), [v3 c22 P22](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0022), [v3 c22 P26](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0026)_

## Traits

- Mischievous  <sub>[v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020)</sub>
- Inquisitive  <sub>[v3 c22 P26](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0026)</sub>
- Fear of ghosts or walking dead  <sub>[v2 c22 P28](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Stella Fletcher when grown up  <sub>[v3 c22 P35](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0035), [v3 c22 P39](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0039)</sub>

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora are taken in at Green Gables by Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley. Following the death of their relative Richard Keith, a trust fund of two thousand dollars is left for Davy and Dora, enabling them to remain permanently at Green Gables. Davy attends Avonlea School and Sunday School, though he occasionally plays truant or gets into mischief, such as diving off hen-house roofs into straw with the Cotton children or accidentally falling onto lemon pies in the pantry. During a severe storm, he is safely guided home by Anne. Over time, he forms a deep attachment to Anne, whom he likes for 'being you', and regularly confides his childhood thoughts and wedding aspirations to her.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P41](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0041), [v2 c19 P42](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0042), [v2 c17 P27](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0027), [v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v2 c24 P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v3 c22 P35](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0035)_
